svg.title: Two swarms under two kernels: their swarm runs under their kernel, joined by a treaty over iroh to your kernel, where both kernels sign. Your swarm runs under your kernel, a trusted compute base of capabilities, delegation, guards, budgets, revocation, information flow, processes, receipts, keys, secrets, sandbox and quarantine around its decision models. Your kernel dispatches through the adapter, the one door into the sandbox, to files, commands and services, and signs each decision.
